note: Recast from Sjöstedt 1925; the original is in German and describes the alate only.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Wings hyaline, tinged with yellowish brown; anterior margin of the pronotum entire (without a notch); ocelli shortly oval, separated from the eyes by about 5/6 of their long diameter; media with 2—3 branches on the basal stalk. Measurements: wingspan 68 mm, fore wing length 32 mm.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Type locality: British East Africa (collected by Lindblom); type specimens in the Stockholm Museum. The original records it as closest to Odontotermes badius and O. transvaalensis.
